npc1: ^I will give you a very important quest.
garatge: ^Hola... Aquí pots equipar diferents armes a la nau.
^Pel moment tens disponible la metralleta i l'escopeta.
^La característica principal de la metralleta és el seu tir ràpid.
^L'escopeta és una arma que té múltiples dispars però de poc abast.
npc_pres: ^La teva missió serà la d'alliberar la galàxia.
^De moment ves al garatge que es troba aquí a sota.
tir: ^Et trobes en la zona de tir amic.
^Aquí podràs practicar la teva destresa amb les armes.
^Que pensaves que enviaríem a qualsevol a lluitar?
cinem1: ^Inside lies the truth of what happened... and the price we paid to survive.
^It began as a day like any other. Ships left the harbour; the Ohexa promised a plentiful day from the sea.
^But deep in the shadows, a group of occultists was trying to summon a feral creature. Usually, their chants fall on deaf ears… But the universe was corrupted enough to make the impossible happen.
^They made it; suddenly a big storm started, and an ominous kraken appeared in front of a ship… in no time all was destroyed.
^Umiko, our Ohexa, thought about how to defeat the beast.
^No mortal commanded the tides as she did… But the monster was stronger.
^With her final breath, she bound the beast to her own soul. She saved us all, but at a terrible cost: she is doomed to guard the monster in the abyss for eternity.
^When that happened, those pillars appeared; if they fall, the seal breaks, and the Kraken returns.
^Destroy them and talk to the fisherman on the port; he will help you. Save Umiko, save us all… kill that monster.
